requirements: R1: Implement automatic access restriction to closed strains and analytical reports based on Moodle departments and courses
R2: Fix approval criteria to strictly ensure no PR is approved when brief requirements like Moodle access restrictions are omitted

slices.title: Resolve closed strains and report access control defects
slices.jtbd: When implementing the follow-up fix for this epic, I want all outstanding PR omissions addressed directly, so that the system enforces the specified Moodle access restrictions and properly rejects incomplete PRs.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a closed strain or analytical report, When queried by a user, Then the system filters access strictly based on the user's Moodle departments and courses.
Given an automated PR review, When evaluating code that omits mandated requirements, Then the reviewer issues a 'block' instead of 'approve'.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Access control and PR review pipeline
